units.source_text: 祇园咚咚锵的奏乐声非常单调。

en.t: The Gion festival music, with its dong-dong-clang rhythm, is extremely monotonous.

units.source_text: 实际上是有二十六套音乐，它像壬生狂言 [5] 的伴奏，也似雅乐 [6] 的乐声。

en.t: In fact, there are twenty-six pieces of music; they sound like the accompaniment to Mibu kyogen [5], and also resemble the tones of gagaku [6].
